page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on KVM virtualization, providing a balanced 1:4 processor-to-memory architecture. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Hardware resources comprise 12 dedicated virtual CPUs across 6 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled, accompanied by 35 MB of L3 cache and 48 GB of system memory (4 GB per vCPU). The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, requiring external cloud block storage for persistent filesystem management.

Benchmark measurements indicate solid multi-core throughput alongside modest single-core execution speed. The instance achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 4589.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 10042.2, placing its aggregate parallel processing in the middle tier. In contrast, single-core benchmarks such as Geekbench single-core (905.0) and single-threaded gzip compression (19.02 GB/sec) test in lower percentiles, reflecting the older Broadwell-generation microarchitecture. Memory subsystem tests show uncached read throughput of 56.47 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 44.31 GB/sec, while in-memory operations reached 8.35 million Redis SET operations per second.

Networking performance is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Due to its dedicated core allocation and balanced memory ratio, ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge provides predictable resource allocation without CPU bursting constraints. However, applications requiring high per-thread burst speeds, extreme I/O throughput, or hardware acceleration will face architectural limitations on this platform.

The ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge instance functions best for scale-out enterprise workloads that utilize multi-threaded parallelism across 12 vCPUs. Fitting production use cases include enterprise backend application servers, multi-threaded build systems, medium-volume web application clusters, Redis caching layers, and relational or document database engines utilizing remote block volumes.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge is a general-purpose instance providing 12 dedicated vCPUs and 48 GB of RAM on KVM virtualization. Powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz with 35 MB of L3 cache, it delivers a consistent 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio across 6 physical cores. The instance features no local storage and relies on network-attached storage, supported by a 2 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark results demonstrate mid-range multi-threaded performance, recording a PassMark CPU score of 10042.2, a Geekbench multi-core score of 4589.0, and 8.35 million Redis SET operations per second, though single-thread benchmarks place in lower percentiles. The lack of hardware accelerators and modest per-core throughput make it less suited for intensive compute or real-time ML inference. It serves effectively as a stable environment for enterprise backend applications, Redis caches, CI/CD build workers, and containerized microservices.
